instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Ali Fahim Ni'ma
subject: 04_Advanced_Software_Eng

questions.question: What does the Iterative-Enhancement Model combine?
questions.question_ar: ما الذي يجمعه نموذج التحسين التكراري؟
options: Repeated linear cycles with prototype input.
One final release after a frozen design.
Risk reviews without product development.
Parallel coding without customer review.
options_en: Repeated linear cycles with prototype input.
One final release after a frozen design.
Risk reviews without product development.
Parallel coding without customer review.
options_ar: تكرار تتابعات خطية مع مراجعة النماذج.
إصدار نهائي بعد تثبيت التصميم مبكراً.
questions.explanation: Iterative Enhancement repeats linear development sequences and uses customer evaluation to guide later increments. It is not a single frozen release or risk analysis without development.
questions.explanation_ar: يكرر التحسين التكراري تتابعات التطوير الخطية ويستخدم تقييم العميل لتوجيه الدفعات اللاحقة. وليس إصداراً واحداً ثابتاً أو تحليلاً للمخاطر بلا تطوير.

questions.question: What does incremental development deliver?
options: a specification frozen first
working product increments
only a completed test plan
one final product delivery
options_en: a specification frozen first
working product increments
only a completed test plan
one final product delivery
questions.explanation: Each increment adds usable functionality that the customer can actually run.
questions.explanation_ar: كل دفعة تضيف وظيفة صالحة يمكن للعميل تشغيلها فعلاً.

questions.question: What does iterative development repeat?
options: one final acceptance test only
the whole project restarted from zero
cycles that revise earlier work
requirements gathered once only
options_en: one final acceptance test only
the whole project restarted from zero
cycles that revise earlier work
requirements gathered once only
questions.explanation: Iteration revisits the same artefact and improves it, rather than adding new scope.
questions.explanation_ar: التكرار يعود للأثر نفسه ويحسّنه، بدل إضافة نطاق جديد.

questions.question: Which one adds new functionality?
options: both add new features
iterative development
both repeat development
incremental development
options_en: both add new features
iterative development
both repeat development
incremental development
questions.explanation: Increments grow the scope; iterations refine what already exists.
questions.explanation_ar: الدفعات توسّع النطاق، والتكرارات تنقّح الموجود.

questions.question: What is the main risk of incremental delivery?
options: integration problems between increments
excessive documentation in every phase
an early frozen design for the whole system
no customer contact during development
options_en: integration problems between increments
excessive documentation in every phase
an early frozen design for the whole system
no customer contact during development
options_ar: توثيق مفرط خلال جميع مراحل المشروع
questions.explanation: Separately built increments can clash at their interfaces if integration is deferred.
questions.explanation_ar: الدفعات المبنية منفصلة قد تتصادم عند واجهاتها إذا أُجّل التكامل.

questions.question: What often characterizes the first Iterative-Enhancement increment?
questions.question_ar: ما السمة الشائعة للدفعة الأولى في التحسين التكراري؟
options: the final deployment before customer review
a core product with essential features
the complete planned system in one release
a throw-away model for user review
options_en: the final deployment before customer review
a core product with essential features
the complete planned system in one release
a throw-away model for user review
options_ar: نموذج أولي مؤقت لعرض شكل النظام.
questions.explanation: The first increment is often a core product that meets basic requirements; later increments add and refine capabilities after review.
questions.explanation_ar: غالباً ما تكون الدفعة الأولى منتجاً أساسياً يحقق المتطلبات الضرورية، ثم تضيف الدفعات اللاحقة القدرات وتنقحها بعد المراجعة.

questions.question: Why is change cheaper under incremental delivery?
questions.question_ar: لماذا التغيير أرخص في التسليم التزايدي؟
options: the development team is always larger
requirements stay frozen throughout work
feedback arrives early in development
testing is never needed later
options_en: the development team is always larger
requirements stay frozen throughout work
feedback arrives early in development
testing is never needed later
options_ar: وصول التغذية الراجعة في وقت مبكر
questions.explanation: Early increments expose mistakes while they are still cheap to correct.
questions.explanation_ar: الدفعات المبكرة تكشف الأخطاء وهي ما تزال رخيصة التصحيح.

questions.question: How are services organized in incremental delivery?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُنظّم الخدمات في التسليم التزايدي؟
options: They are all postponed until one final release.
They follow an order chosen by the compiler.
They are frozen after a throw-away prototype.
They are prioritized across product releases.
options_en: They are all postponed until one final release.
They follow an order chosen by the compiler.
They are frozen after a throw-away prototype.
They are prioritized across product releases.
options_ar: تؤجل كلها إلى إصدار نهائي واحد.
questions.explanation: Incremental delivery prioritizes services and assigns parts of the system to releases. Later requirements can be analyzed while an earlier release is developed.
questions.explanation_ar: يرتب التسليم التزايدي الخدمات حسب الأولوية ويوزع أجزاء النظام على إصدارات. ويمكن تحليل المتطلبات اللاحقة أثناء تطوير إصدار سابق.

questions.question: What can happen to requirements for later increments while the first is developed?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يمكن أن يحدث لمتطلبات الدفعات اللاحقة أثناء تطوير الأولى؟
options: They can be analyzed as the first release is developed.
They must be implemented before the first release is built.
They are discarded after the core product is tested.
They are defined after the system runs for years.
options_en: They can be analyzed as the first release is developed.
They must be implemented before the first release is built.
They are discarded after the core product is tested.
They are defined after the system runs for years.
options_ar: يمكن تحليلها مع تطوير الإصدار الأول.
يجب تنفيذها قبل بناء الإصدار الأول.
تُحدد بعد تشغيل النظام زمناً طويلاً.
questions.explanation: Incremental development allows later requirements to be analyzed while the first release is being built. This supports staged delivery without requiring every feature up front.
questions.explanation_ar: يتيح التطوير التزايدي تحليل المتطلبات اللاحقة أثناء بناء الإصدار الأول. وهذا يدعم التسليم المرحلي دون اشتراط كل الخصائص منذ البداية.

questions.question: What integration problem can occur across Iterative-Enhancement increments?
questions.question_ar: ما مشكلة التكامل التي قد تظهر بين دفعات التحسين التكراري؟
options: The core product cannot receive added capabilities.
A later increment may require changes to earlier software.
A later increment must erase earlier requirements.
Customer reviews prevent modules from being integrated.
options_en: The core product cannot receive added capabilities.
A later increment may require changes to earlier software.
A later increment must erase earlier requirements.
Customer reviews prevent modules from being integrated.
options_ar: يعجز المنتج الأساسي عن إضافة قدرات جديدة.
قد تحتاج دفعة إلى تعديل برمجيات سابقة.
تلغي الدفعة اللاحقة جميع المتطلبات السابقة.
تمنع مراجعة العميل دمج الوحدات في النظام.
questions.explanation: Later increments may require modifications to earlier software. This creates an integration and dependency risk, not a rule to erase prior work.
questions.explanation_ar: يذكر النص احتمال تعطل التوافق بين الدفعات، إذ قد تتطلب الدفعات اللاحقة تعديلات في السابقة. وهذا خطر تكامل واعتماد، لا قاعدة لمحو العمل السابق.
